title: Linen Santa bags
text: Linen Santa bags. I was so hopeful for these - however, I would highly recommend you do not purchase.  The arrived individually wrapped in a cello type wrap.  I opened and the stink just hits you. Smelled like musty old socks and an odd combination of stale petroleum products.  It was really strong.  So I didn't want to put my grandsons toys in them.  I made the choice to wash them (turned inside out) on the handwash cycle and tumble dry on fluff cycle ( meaning no heat). No harm right?  I mean they are a thin type of linen. I couldn't have been more wrong. They literally fell apart completely.  The hems didn't open, they frayed - bottom, top, sides.  The draw strings were the thinnest most ridiculous thing you can imagine.  They were thinner than most shoe laces.  I had hoped the boys would be able to use these bags again, but good heavens, what a joke. You couldn't use them without washing them and they couldn't even take a gentle soaking wash.  I returned them both.  I am so disappointed because these would have been so nice - so much nicer than the bright red fuzzy or plastic bags.  Considering the price you would have thought they'd have lasted a few years. I will update if the return process is hindered in some way.
